extracted.intended_audience: Heads of executive departments and establishments; federal procurement officials
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register final notice and OMB transmittal rescinding OMB Circular No. A-49 ("Use of Management and Operating Contracts") and directing that policy and guidance on such contracts be found in the Federal Acquisition Regulation and related OFPP guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescission of OMB Circular No. A-49
rubrics_metrics.description: Office of Management and Budget Circular No. 49 is hereby rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final notice of rescission published in the Federal Register (Vol. 51, No. 24, Feb 5, 1986). The transmittal memorandum states the circular is cancelled; the action finalizes the recommendation of the Assistant Secretaries for Management and was supported by agency comments responding to the proposed rescission (see 50 FR 40849).

rubrics_metrics.name: Location of policy and guidance for management and operating contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and guidance affecting the use of management and operating contracts is found in the Federal Acquisition Regulation, Subpart 17.6, and in other related regulations and directives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice directs practitioners to rely on the FAR (Subpart 17.6 cited; an OCR instance shows Subpart 17.8 in one line) and other implementing regulations rather than Circular A-49. It also references OFPP Policy Letter 84-1 ('Federally Funded Research and Development Centers') as relevant guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rationale based on agency comments and existing comprehensive guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The circular is cancelled because responses from Government agencies reaffirmed that comprehensive guidance currently exists in the FAR, OFPP Policy Letter 84-1, and agency implementing regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments received in response to the Proposed Notice of Rescission (Nov 13, 1985; 50 FR 40849) were overwhelmingly supportive, which the notice cites as justification for rescission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness of the rescission/transmittal memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: Transmittal Memorandum No.1 to OMB Circular No. A-49 is effective as of the date of this notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice states the rescission is effective upon issuance; the Federal Register citation and transmittal dates are provided in the document for administrative record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated contact for questions or further information regarding the rescission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For further information contact Mr. Robert C. Bienvenue, Office of Federal Procurement Policy, (202) 395-3254 (as listed in the Federal Register notice).
